s: vya, (am + kvip, svarAditvAdavyayatvamasya .) SIGratA । alpaM । iti vyAqiH ॥
v: avya॰ cu॰ ama--kvip svarAdi॰ । 1 alpe 2 SIGratAyAYca
m: 1. अम् ind. quickly, a little, (g. चादि, q.v.)
2. अम् the termination अम् in the comparative and other forms used as ind., e.g. प्रतरम्, &c., (g. स्वर्-आदि, q.v.)

3. अम् अमति, to go, L.; to go to or towards, L.; to serve or honour, L.; to sound, L.; (Imper. Ā. 2. sg. अमीष्व; aor. आमीत्; cf. अभ्य्-√ अम्) to fix, render firm, TS.; (perf. p. acc. sg. एमुषम् for एमिवांसम्) to be pernicious or dangerous, RV. viii, 77, 10 : Caus. आमयति (impf. आमयत्; aor. Subj. आममत्) to be afflicted or sick, RV.; AV.; VS. (cf. अन्-आमयत्).
a: अम् — ind. 1 Quickly. --2 A little.

अम् — {c1c} P. [अमति अमितुं, अमित; Ved. pres. अमिति; अमीति] 1 To go; to go to or towards. --2 To serve, honour. --3 To sound. --4 To eat. {c10c} P. or Caus. ( आमयति) 1 To come upon, attack, afflict with sickness or pain from disease. --2 To be ill or be afflicted or diseased. --With सं Ved. {c1c} A. {1} to convince oneself of, ascertain. {2} to ally or connect oneself with. --3 To fix or settle oneself.

strI, (na mAti kzayodayaviSezaM paricCinatti, mA + ka, naYsamAsaH .) amAvasyA । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ candramaRqalasya zoqaSakalA । taTA ca skandapurARIyapraBAsaKaRqe । “amA zoqaSaBAgena devi proktA mahAkalA । saMsTitA paramA mAyA dehinAM dehaDAriRI” ॥ asyArTaH । candramaRqalasya zoqaSaBAgena parimitA ADAraSaktirUpA kzayodayarahitatvAt nityA sraksUtravat sarvvAnusyUtA amA nAmnI mahAkalA poktA । iti raGunandanaH ॥ (saha । sArdDaM । samIpaM । nikawaM । antikaM .)
v: avya॰ na + mA--kA । 1 sahArTe, amevAnaH suhavAH” f॰ 2, 36, 3 । “amA saha BA॰” । amAvasyA । 2 nikawe ca । na mAti paricCinatti kzayodayaviSezam mA--ka na॰ ta॰ । sarvva kalAvyApakatayA sTitAyAM candrasya zoqaSyAM 3 kalAyAm strI “amA zoqaSaBAgena devi! proktA mahAkalA saMsTitA paramA mAyA dehinAM dehaDAriRI amAdipOrRRamAsyantAyA eva SaSinaH kalAH । tiTayastAH samAKyAtAH zoqaSEva varAnane!” iti ska॰ praBA॰ Ka॰ । vyAKyAta cEtat kAlamADavIye “mahAmAyA ADAraSaktirUpA dehinAM dehaDAriRI sA candramaRqalasya zoqaSaBAgena parimitA candradehaDAriRI amAnAmnI mahAkaleti proktA kzayodayarahitA nityA tiTisaMjYikEva itarA api paYcadaSa kalA divasavyavahA ro payoginyaH kzayodayavatyaH paYcadaSa tiTayo BavantIti tiTayaH zoqaSEva evaYcAtra sAmAnyaviSezarUpeRa tiTidvEvi DyamuktaM Bavati । tatra yeyam ametyuktA kzayodayavarjjitA DruvA zoqaSI kalA tadyuktaH kAlastiTisAmAnyam । yAstvavaSizwA vfdDikzayopetAH paYcadaSa kalAstABiH viSizwakAlaviBAgastiTiviSeza” iti । aDikaM tiTiSabde vakzyate sUryyakiraRAsaMparkAdadIptAyAM, 4 paYcadaSyAM kalAyAm na mIyate dfSyate viGuratra । 5 amAvasyAyAM tiTO ca strI । “amArkapAte SravaRaM yadi syAt” “yadyamA ravivAreRa” iti ca prA॰ ta॰ purA॰ । “amAyAM tu sadA soma--ozaDIH pratipadyate” iti somo॰ । na mIyate'sO mA--karmaRi kvip । 6 Atmani pu॰ । 7 mAnaSUnye tri॰ । 8 gfhe avya॰ niru॰ । “kAmaScaratAmamA BUte” f॰ 2, 38, 6 । “amA gfhamiti” BA॰ । amyate gamyate candralokAt atra ama--ADAre--GaY vA hrasvaH । 9 ihaloke । “amAtomarutovi AntarikzAdamAyuta” f॰ 5, 50, 58 । “amAtaH asmAllokAt” BA॰ । tatra yAvatsampAtamuzitvA “kzoRe puRye martyalokaM viSantIti” SrutO candralokAdeva iha lokAgamanAttaTAtvam ।
m: अमा See ss.vv.
1. अमा ind. (Ved. instr. fr. 2. अम, q.v.) (chiefly Ved.) at home, in the house, in the house of (gen.), with, RV. &c.
together, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 122
अमा (आ) f. = अमा-वास्या, q.v. Comm. on Ragh. xiv, 80 (in a verse quoted from Vyāsa) Comm. on Sūryas.
2. अ-मा (√ 3. मा) f. (= अ-प्रमाण) not an authority, not a standard of action, Nyāyam.
a: अमा — a. [न मा-का] Measureless. --ind. Ved. 1 At home, in the house; कामश्चरताममाभूत् Rv. 2. 38. 6. --2 In this world, here below (इहलोके). --3 With, near, close to; अमैवासां तद्भवति Śat. Br. --4 Together with, in conjunction or company with, as in अमात्य, अमावास्या q. v.; अमाकृ to draw near, have near oneself. --f. 1 The day of the new moon, the day of the conjunction of the sun and moon; अमायां तु सदा सोम अषेधीः प्रतिपद्यते Vyāsa. --2 The sixteenth digit of the moon. --3 The fifteenth digit also. --m. The soul. --Comp. --अक्त a. Ved. met, come together. --अंतः the end of the day of new moon. --जुर् f. living at home during life, growing old at home; Rv. 10. 39. 3; being without husband in the same dwelling with her parents, as a maiden ( पितृषद्); Rv. 2. 17. 7. --पर्वन् n. the sacred time of अमा, day of new moon.

k.v: अमा सह समीपे च कं वारिणि च मूर्धनि। इवेत्थमर्थयोरेवं नूनं तर्केऽर्थनिश्चये॥
अमा सह समीपे च कं वारिणि च मूर्धनि। इवेत्थमर्थयोरेवं नूनं तर्केऽर्थनिश्चये॥

m: अ-मांसाशन mfn. id., Viṣṇus.
अ-मांसाशिन् mfn. id., ŚBr. xiv; KātyŚr.; PārGṛ.

s: tri, (nAsti mAMsaM yasya saH .) durbbalaH । ityamaraH ॥ alpamAMsayuktaH । mAMsarahitaSca ॥ (kfSaH । kzIRakAyaH । nirAmizaBakzyavastu .)
v: tri॰ nAsti mAMsaM yasya । 1 durbbale । mAMsahIno hi durbbalaH ।
m: अ-मांस n. not flesh, anything but flesh, KātyŚr.
अ-मांस mfn. without flesh, PārGṛ.
feeble, thin, L.
a: अमांस — a. 1 Without flesh, not containing flesh. --2 Lean, thin, weak, enfeebled. --सं Not flesh, any thing but flesh. --Comp. --ओदनिक a. (की f.) not relating to a preparation of rice with meat.

k.v: अमांसो दुर्बलश्छातो बलवान्मांसलोंऽसलः। तुन्दिलस्तुन्दिभस्तुन्दी बृहत्कुक्षिः पिचण्डिलः॥

m: अ-मांस—भक्ष mfn. not eating flesh, Kathās.
अ-मांसक mfn. without flesh, TS.
अमा—हठ m. N. of a snake demon, MBh. i, 2157.
अमा-हठ See 1. अमा.
अमा—जुर् ऊर्, f. living at home, growing old at home (as a maiden), RV. ii, 17, 7; viii, 21, 15 and x, 39, 3.
अमा—√ कृ (g. साक्षाद्-अदि, q.v.), Ved. to have or take with one's self, AV.; ŚBr. &c.

v: strI amA saha sUryyeRa mAH mAso vA candramA yasyAM gOrA॰ NIz । amAvasyAyAm ।
m: अमा-मासी, अमा-मसी, v.l. for -वासी, -वसी, q.v., L.

s: strI, (amA saha sUryyeRa mAso yasyAM, gOrAditvAt NIz । pfzodarAditvAt hrasvaH .) amAvasyA । ityamarawIkAyAM ramAnATaH ॥
a: अमाम(मा)सी — = अमावसी or अमावास्या q. v.

m: अ-मान n. = 2. अ-मा, Nyāyam.

v: strI aBAve na॰ ta॰ । AdarABAve na॰ ba॰ । AdaraSUnye tri॰ ।

m: अ-मानन n. disrespect, Hit.
a: अमाननं, --ना — Disrespect, insult; disobedience.

v: na॰ mAnase sADu na Bavati mAnasa + yat na॰ ta॰ । manaH kazwadAyake duHKe ।
m: अ-मानस्य = आमनस्य, q.v., L.
a: अमानस्यं — Pain(मानसे साधु न भवति).

m: अ-मान—ता f. = अमा-त्व (s.v. 2. अ-मा), ib.
अ-मानव mfn. ‘not human, superhuman’, and ‘not being a descendant of Manu’, Śiś. i, 67.
अ-मानव See अ-मनुष्य.
a: अमानव — a. 1 Not human; animal. --2 Superhuman.

v: tri॰ na manyate'mimanyate mana--Rini na॰ ta॰ । aBimAnaSUnye “amAnitvamadamBitvam” gItA ।
m: अ-मानिन् mfn. (√ मन्), not proud, modest, MBh.
a: अमानिन् — a. Modest, humble.

m: अमानि-ता, f. or अमानि-त्व [Bhag. &c.], n. modesty, humility.
a: अमानिता, --त्वं — Modesty, humility.

m: 1. अमान्त m. the end, of the अमा (-वास्या) night, ib.
अ-मानुषी f. a female animal, Gaut.
अ-मानुष mf(ई)n. not human, anything but a man, RV. x, 95, 8
superhuman, divine, celestial, R. &c.
inhuman, brutal, RV.
अ-मानुष mf(आ)n., without men, not inhabited by men, Kathās.
अ-मानुष m. not a man, ŚBr.; AitBr.; Mn. ix, 284
अ-मानुष &c. See अ-मनुष्य.
a: अमानुष — a. (षी f.) 1 Not human, not belonging to man, supernatural, unearthly, superhuman; आकृतिरेवानुमापयत्यमानुषतां K. 132; ˚आकृतिः K. 131, 132, 258; ˚शक्तित्वं 103; ˚गीतध्वनिं 126 an unearthly melody. --2 Inhuman, monster-like; ill-disposed towards man. --3 Tenantless, desolate; ˚षं वनं 135. --षः, --षी One not a man, an irrational animal; Ms. 9. 284, Ś. 5. 22.

m: अ-मानुष—लोक m. ‘the celestial world’, heaven, Kād.
अ-मानुष्य mfn. not human, MBh. xiv, 266.
a: अमानुष्य — a. Not human, superhuman &c.

s: tri, (man + karmmaRi Ryat, naYsamAsaH .) amAnanIyaH । anAdftyaH । mAnyaSabdasya naYA samAsaH ॥

m: अमा-पुत्रा f. (with दृषद्) the larger with the smaller mill-stone, Kauś.
अमा-पुत्र mf(आ)n. together with the son or daughter
अ-माप्य mfn. immeasurable, Vajracch.
अ-मार m. non-destruction, Rājat.
a: अमारः — Not dying.

m: अ-मारक mfn. not killing, Sāy. on RV. i, 84, 4.
अ-मार्ग m. a bad road, (also figuratively) an evil path, Rājat.; Kathās.
अ-मार्ग mfn. pathless, L.
a: अमार्ग — a. Pathless. --र्गः Not a road, absence of road; a bad road.

m: अ-मार्ग—प्रसृत् mfn. (√ सृ), one who is out of the right way, Car.
अ-मार्गेण ind. instr. in a dishonourable manner, MBh. ii, 2035

v: tri॰ mfja--kta viroDe na॰ ta॰ । aparizkfte ।
m: अ-मार्जित mfn. uncleansed, unwashed, MBh. iii, 2577.
अमात् See ss.vv.
1. अमात् ind. (abl.) from near at hand, RV. v, 53, 8 and ix, 97, 8.
2. अ-मात् m(nom. sg. आन्)fn. (pr. p. √ 3. मा), not measuring, not affording room or space, boundless (in qualities), Śiś. xiii, 2; Nalod.
a: अमात् — ind. Ved. From near, at hand. --a. Not measuring.

m: अमातापुत्राध्यापक m. a teacher who cares for neither mother nor son (on account of being entirely absorbed in his work), Pāṇ. viii, 1, 67, Kāś.
अ-माता-पुत्र mfn. (g. काष्ठादि, q.v.) ‘having neither mother nor son’, only in comp., e.g. अमातापुत्राध्यापक
अ-मातृ f. not a mother, ŚBr. xiv.
a: अमातृ --तृक — a. Motherless.
अमातृभोगीण — a. Not fit for the use of a mother.

m: अ-मातृक mfn. motherless, Āp.

v: pu॰ nAsti mAtrA paricCittiryasya । 1 iyattASUnye paramAtmani turIye brahmaRi । vfhatparimARakalpanena 2 paricCedaSUnye gaganAdO ca triM॰ । amAtraM tvA DizaRaM tavize f॰ 1, 102, 7, “amAtraM mAtrayA iyattayA rahitam” BA॰ ।
m: अ-मात्र mfn. without measure, boundless (as Indra), RV. i, 102, 7
(as Brahman), BṛĀrUp.
not metrical or prosodical, MāṇḍUp. having the measure or quantity of the letter अ, VPrāt.
अ-मात्र See 2. अ-मा.
a: अमात्र — a. [नास्ति मात्रा इयत्ता यस्य] 1 Boundless, immeasurable. --2 Not whole or entire. --3 Not elementary. --4 Having the measure or quantity of the letter अ. --त्रं 1 Non-measure. --2 Not a measure or quantity. --त्रः The Supreme Spirit.
अमात्रवत्वं — 1 Spirit, spiritual essence. --2 Defect, deficiency.

m: अ-मात्रया ind. (instr. f.) in a boundless manner, Kathās.
अ-मात्सर्य n. disinterestedness, MBh. v, 1640.
अ-मात्सर्य See अ मत्सर.
अ-मात्सर्य—ता f. id., Lalit.
अ-मा—त्व n. the not being an authority, ib.

s: puM, (amA saha vidyate, amA + tyap .) mantrI । ityamaraH ॥ tatparIkzA । yaTA, -- “SAnto vinItaH kuSalaH satkulInaH SuBAnvitaH । SAstrArTatattvago'mAtyo BavedBUmiBujAmiha” ॥ iti yuktikalpataruH ॥ (“BftA hi pARqunAmAtyA balaYca satataM BftaM । mAnyAnanyAnamAtyAMSca brAhmaRASca tapoDanAn” ॥ iti mahABArate .)
v: pu॰ amA saha vasati tyak । mantriRi । tasya daRqanItO rAjasahacaratvAttaTAtvam । “purohitAmAtyamuKASca yoDAH” BawwiH । “amAtyaputrEH savayoBiranvitaH” raGuH । “amAtye daRqa Ayatta” iti manuH “amAtyavyaYjanA rAjYAM dUzyAste SatrusaMhitAH” mAGaH । amAtyalakzaRamuktaM hemA॰ vizRuDa॰ pu॰ । “sarvvalakzaRalakzaRyo mantrI rAjYastaTA Bavet । brAhmaRo vedatattvajYovinotaH priyadarSanaH । Calalakzye mahAtmA ca svAmiBaktaH priyavadaH । vfhaspatyuSanaHproktAM nItiM jAnAti sarvvataH । rAgadvezeRa yaH kAryaM na ca hanti mahIkzitaH । lokApavAdAdrAjArTe BayaM yasya na vidyate । kleSakzamastu DarmmAtmA vijitAtmA jitendriyaH । gUQamantraScA'SvadakzaH prAjYo BaktajanapriyaH । iNgitAkAratattvajYa UhApohaviSAradaH । SUraSva jYAtavidyaScana mAnI na ca matsarI । cArapracArakuSalaH praRiGiprARa AtmavAn । zAqguRyaviDitattvajYa upAyakuSalastayA । vettA viDAtA kAryyARAM nEva kAryyAtipAtanaH । samayajYaSca kAlajYo BftyAnAYca guRapriyaH । kftAnAmakftAnAM ca karmaRAmanvavekzitA । yaTA puruzamarhARAM puruzARAM niyojakaH! karttA parokze kAryyARi sAMparAye BfgUttama । tattvAtattvaveditA ca karmaRo gurulAGavam । SatrumitraviBAgajYo vignahe cEva tattvavit sa rAjYaH sarvvakAryyARi kuryAdBfgukulodvaha! viditAni taTA kuryAnna jYAtAni mahIkzitA ajYAtAni narendrasya kftvA kAryyARi BArgava! acireRApi vidvezaM sa mantrI tvaDigacCati । kurute yastu kAryyARi viditAni mahIpateH Bedo na tasya Bavati kadAcidapi BUBujA evaMguRo yasya Bavettu mantrI vAkye ca tasyABiratasya rAjYaH । rAjyaM sTiraM syAdvipulA ca lakzmIryaSaSca dIptaM Buvanatraye'pi” iti ।
m: अमात्य m. (4) (fr. 1. अमा cf. Pāṇ. iv, 2, 104, Sch.) inmate of the same house, belonging to the same house or family, RV. vii, 15, 3; VS.; ĀśvGṛ.; KātyŚr.
‘a companion (of a king)’, minister, MBh.; Mn. &c.
अमात्य See 1. अमा
a: अमात्यः — (अमा सह वसति, अमा-त्यप्, P. IV. 2. 104 Vārt.) 1 One living with or near another, an inmate of the same house or family (Ved.). --2 A companion or follower of a king, minister; अमात्यपुत्रैः सवयोभिरन्वितः R. 3. 28.

k.v: राजन्यकं च नृपतिक्षत्रियाणां गणे क्रमात्. मन्त्री धीसचिवोऽमात्योऽन्ये कर्मसचिवास्ततः॥
अध्वनीनोऽध्वगोऽध्वन्यः पान्थः पथिक इत्यपि। स्वाम्यमात्यसुहृत्कोशराष्ट्रदुर्गबलानि च॥

s: strI, (amA sAhityena candrArkayorvAso yatra, gOrAditvAt NIz .) amAvasyA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: अमा—वासी f. = -वास्या, q.v., MBh. i, 4644 and R. vi, 72, 66 (only loc. ˚स्याम्, which might be a metrical abbreviation for ˚स्यायाम्).

s: strI, (amA saha candrArkO vasato yatra tiTO sA, amA + vasa + ADAre Ryat, striyAM wAp । RitvAt vfdDiH .) amAvasItiTiH । ityamaraH ॥
m: अमा—वास्या (-वास्या), f. (scil. रात्रि; fr. √ 5. वस्, ‘to dwell’, with अमा, ‘together’) the night of new moon (when the sun and moon ‘dwell together’), the first day of the first quarter on which the moon is invisible, AV.; ŚBr. &c.
a sacrifice offered at that time
N. of the Acchodā river, MatsyaP.
अमा-वास्या See ib.

k.v: कलाहीने सानुमतिः पूर्णे राका निशाकरे। अमावास्या त्वमावस्या दर्शः सूर्येन्दुसङ्गमः॥

m: अमा—वास्य n. [NBD.] neighbourhood, AV. iv, 36, 3 [perhaps for -वाश्य, ‘lowing (of cows) at home’, as the word is used together with आ-गर & प्रति-क्रोश]
अमा—वास्य mfn. born in an अमा-वास्या night, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 30 (cf. आमावास्य)
N. of a Vedic teacher, VBr.
a: अमावास्य, --स्यक — a. [अमावास्या, वुन्-अष् P. IV. 3. 30-31; अमावास्यायां जातः] Born or produced on the night of new moon.

m: अमा—वास्यक mfn. (= -वास्य) born in an अमा-वास्या night, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 30.

s: strI, (amA sAhityena vasataScandrArkO yasyAM, amA + vasa + aDikaraRe gOrAditvAt NIz .) amAvAsyA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: strI amA saha vasataScandrArkO yasyAm ap vaY vA ni॰ gOrA॰ NIz । amAvAsyAyAm ।
m: अमा—वसी f. = वास्या, q.v., L.
अमा-वसी &c. See 1. अमा.

v: pu॰ Ayuputre fziBede “amAvasumiti KyAtamAyoH putraM yaSasvigam” ha॰ baM॰ ।
m: अमा—वसु m. N. of a prince (a descendant of Purūravas), MBh.; Hariv.; VP.

s: strI, (amA sAhityena vasataScandrArkO yasyAM, amA + vasa + ADAre Ryat striyAM wAp .) kfzRapakzAntatiTiH । sA tu candramaRqalasya paYcadaSakalAkriyArUpA tatkriyopalakzitaH kAlo vA । iti tiTyAditattvaM ॥ sUryyAcandramasoryaH paraH sannikarzaH sAmAvasyA । iti goBilaH ॥ paraH sannikarzaSca uparyyaDoBAvApannasamasUtrapAtanyAyena ekarASyavacCedena sahAvasTAnarUpaH । iti raGunandanaH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । amAvAsyA 2 । darSaH 3 । sUryyendusaNgamaH 4 । ityamaraH ॥ paYcadaSI 5 । iti smftiH ॥ amAvasI 6 । amAvAsI 7 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ amAmasI 8 । amAmAsI 9 । ityamarawIkAyAM ramAnATaH ॥ sA dfzwendukalA sinIvAlI 10 । nazwendukalA ca kuhUH 11 । ityamaraH ॥ tadvyavasTAdi yaTA । aTAmAvasyA । sA ca pratipadyutA grAhyA yugmAt । varAhapurARe cARqAlaSapaTe । “zazWyazwamyapyamAvAsyA uBe pakze caturddaSI । asnAtAnAM gatiM yAsye yadyahaM nAgame punaH” ॥ ato'tra snAnamAvaSyakaM । ato'tra jIvatpitfkeRApi snAtavyam । “amAsnAnaM gayASrAdDaM dakziRAmuKaBojanaM । na jIvatpitfkaH kuryyAt kfte ca pitfhA Bavet” ॥ iti vacanaM rAgaprAptasnAnanizeDakaM । “BogAya kriyate yattu snAnaM yAdfcCikaM narEH । tannizidDaM daSamyAdO nityanEmittike na tu” ॥ iti trayodaSIprakaraRoktavacanAcca ॥ * ॥ pEWinasiH । “na parbbasu tElaM kzOraM mAMsamaByupeyAt nAmAvAsyAyAM haritamapi CindyAt” । iti ॥ * ॥ “puzye tu janmanakzatre vyatIpAte ca vEDftO । amAyAYca nadIsnAnaM punAtyAsaptamaM kulaM” ॥ atra dahatyAjanmaduzkftamiti jyotize pAWaH ॥ * ॥ vyAsaH । “amAvAsyAM BavedvAro yadi BUmisutasya ca । gosahasraPalaM dadyAt snAnamAtreRa jAhnavI” ॥ “sinIvAlI kuhUrvvApi yadi somadine Bavet । gosahasraPalaM dadyAt snAnaM yanmOninA kftam” ॥ sinIvAlI caturddaSIyuktAmAvAsyA vyastApi praSastA evamanyatrApi vAraviSizwaviDO na yugmAdaraH niravakASatvena saMSayAyogAt । etacca mOnamaruRodayakAlamAraBya snAnaparyyantaM । na tu snAnakAlamAtre । tatra, “uccAreM meTune cEva prasrAve dantaDAvane । snAne BojanakAle ca zawsu mOnaM samAcaret” ॥ iti skAndena tasya sAmAnyataH prAptatvAt । uccAre purIzotsarge ॥ * ॥ smftiH । “karatoyAjalaM prApya yadi somayutA kuhUH । aruRodayavelAyAM sUryyagrahaSatEH samA” ॥ snAnamantraH । “karatoye sadAnIre saritSrezWe suviSrute । pORqrAn plAvayase nityaM pApaM hara karodBave” ॥ pORqrAn deSaviSezAn ॥ * ॥ marIciH । “mAse naBasyamAvAsyA tasyAM darBacayo mataH । ayAtayAmAste darBA viniyojyAH punaH punaH” ॥ atra । “darBAH kfzRAjinaM mantrA brAhmaRA haviragnayaH । ayAtayAmAnyetAni niyojyAni punaH punaH” ॥ iti gfhyapariSizwavacanenEva sidDO SrAvaRAmAvAsyAyA upAdAnaM । “vArzikAMScaturo mAsAnnAharet kuSamfttikAH । AdadIta tvaBAve'pi sadyo yasyopayojanaM” ॥ iti saMvatsarapradIpaDftaSivarahasyIyasyApavAdakamiti ॥ vidyAkaraDftaM । “saNgrahAdvatsaraM yAvat SudDiH syAdiDmavarhizAM । tataH paraM na gfhRIyAt japAdO yajYakarmmaRi” ॥ * ॥ saMvatsarapradIpe । “amAvAsyAntu kanyArke tIrTaprAptO taTA nfpa । kftvA SrAdDaM viDAnena dadyAt zoqaSapiRqakaM” ॥ tatpramARaprayogO zoqaSISabde drazwavyO ॥ * ॥ amAvAsyAyAmapi malamAse SrAdDABAvamAha kOTumiH । “saMvatsarAtireko vE mAso yaH syAttrayodaSaH । tasmiMstrayodaSe SrAdDaM na kuryyAdindusaMkzaye” ॥ sambatsarapradIpe । “ekarASisTite sUryye yadi darSadvayaM Bavet । darSaSrAdDaM tadAdO syAnna paratra malimluce” ॥ yattu । “jAtakarmmaRi yat SrAdDaM darSaSrAdDaM taTEva ca । malamAse'pi tatkAryyaM vyAsasya vacanaM yaTA” ॥ iti vyAsavacanaM tatpiRqapitfyajYAKyaSrAdDaparaM ॥ * ॥ amAvAsyASrAdDakAlamAha CandogapariSizwaM । “piRqAnvAhAryyakaM SrAdDaM kzIRe rAjani Sasyate । vAsarasya tftIyAMSe nAtisanDyAsamIpataH” ॥ piRqAnAM pitFRAM anvAhAryyaM SrAdDaM mAsEkatfptijanakaM yattattaTA । taTA ca manuH । “piRqAnAM mAsikaM SrAdDamanvAhAryyaM vidurbuDAH” । rAjani candre । Sasyata ityanena kvaciccandrakzayABAve'pi amAvAsyASrAdDaM sUcitaM । etAdfgvyutpatteH sAgniniragnisADAraRatvAt vakzyamARakAtyAyanoktarItyA kzIRAstamBitAvardDamAnABedaH sADAraRaH ॥ * ॥ yattu, -- “pitfyajYantu nirvvarttya vipraScandrakzaye'gnimAn । piRqAnvAhAryyakaM SrAdDaM kuryyAnmAsAnumAsikaM” ॥ iti manuvacanaM tatsAgniH piRqapitfyajYaM nirvvartya mAsAnumAsikaM pratimAsikaM SrAdDaM kurvvItetikramaviDAyakaM । atrAnuSabdasya vIpsArTakatvaM । taTA ca । “lakzaRavIpsetTamBratezvaBirBAge paripratI । anurezu sahArTe ca hIne upaSca kaTyate” ॥ candrakzaye'mAvAsyAyAM na tu kAtyAyanoktakzaye taTAtve vardDamAnAdO pratimAsAnupapatteH । evameva SrAdDavivekaH । ataeva tatrEvAmAvAsyAvyatiriktakfzRapakzavihitapArbbaRaSrAdDe yayAstamiti vacanAt vyavasTetyuktaM । tatra sAgnikarttavyatvAviSezitAmAvAsyAvyatirekABiDAnAt kzIRAdiBedena vyavasTA sAgniniragnisADAraRItyavagamyate । evaYcAmAvAsyAyAM mftAhanimittaka OrasakzetrajaputtrakarttavyapArbbaRe kzIyamARAdinA na vyavasTA kintu yayAstamityanena । etadvivftaM malamAsatattve ॥ * ॥ yattu daSamamuhUrttasya matsyapurARoktAparAhRikatve'pi SrAdDe tasya tyAgaH । piRqapitfyajYArTa eveti vAsaratftIyAMSABiDAnaM sAgniparameveti pariSizwaprakASoktaM tanna yuktaM । pUrvvAhRovE devAnAM maDyaM dinaM manuzyARAM aparAhRaH pitFRAM iti SrutyA tanmuhUrttasya manuzyakarmmANgatvena boDanAdeva SrAdDe parityAgaH । etacCrutimUlakameva vAsarasya tftIyAMSa ityuktaM । vAsarasya tftIyAMSe triDA viBaktasya dinasya tftIyaBAge nAtisanDyAsamIpata iti sanDyAsamIpEkamuhUrtta Apadyapi varjjanIya ityarTaH । tena । “prAtaHkAlo muhUrttAMstrIn saNgavastAvadeva tu । maDyAhnastrimuhUrttaH syAdaparAhRastataH paraM ॥ sAyAhnastrimuhUrtraH syAt SrAdDaM tatra na kArayet । rAkzasI nAma sA velA garhitA sarvvakarmmasu” ॥ iti matsyapurARe nizidDamuhUrttatraye Apadi muhUrttadvayamaByanujYAtaM atiSabdasvarasAt । “trimuhUrttApi karttavyA pUrvvA darSA ca bahvfcEH” । iti hArItavacanAcca । tena pUrvvadine muhUrttatrayamAtralABe paradine vAsarasya tftIyAMSAlABe pUrvvadine eva SrAdDaM । etena nAtisanDyAsamIpata ityanena rAkzasIvelAmAtraM niziDyata iti mETilamatamapAstaM । sarvvakarmmasu snAnadAnAdizvapi anApadItyarTaH । iti SrAdDavivekaH ॥ tenASaktO tasyAmapi tatkaraRaM । ataeva parASaraH । “divAkarakarEH pUtaM divAsnAnaM praSasyate । apraSastaM niSi snAnaM rAhoranyatra darSanAt” ॥ iti ॥ * ॥ darSadvEDe kutra SrAdDamityAha CandogapariSizwe kAtyAyanaH । “yadA caturdfSIyAmaM turIyamanupUrayet । amAvAsyA kzIyamARA tadEva SrAdDamizyate” ॥ caturddaSIyAmaM caturddaSIsambanDidinayAmamiti taddinasyAmAvAsyAsambanDe'pi caturddaSInirddeSo'Dikena vyapadeSA BavantIti nyAyAt । tena yadA amAvAsyAcaturddaSIsambanDidinasya caturTaM praharaM kftsnaM kiYcinnyUnaM vA anupUrayet atrAnupUrayedityaBiDAnAt turIyayAmasya pAdonadaRqadvayAnyUnapraTamamuhUrttasya bahukAlatvaM pratIyate । etena praharatrayAByantare kiYcidaDikapraharatraye vA caturddaSI pratIyate । tataScoBayavAsarIyatftIyAMSasambanDipaYcaDAviBaktAparAhUmuhUrttayormuhUrttAnyUnadarSalABe dvEDaM na tvekadinamAtre tallABe । tatra pUrvvoktena vAsarasya tftIyAMSa ityanenEva dvEDAnudayAt । ato yaddine vAsaratftIyAMSe tAdfSadarSalABastatrEva SrAdDaM । muhUrttonatiTestu karmmAnarhatvAnna dvEDAvasaraH । taTA ca Bavizye । “vratopavAsaniyame GawikEkA yadA Bavet । sA tiTiH sakalA jYeyA pitrarTe cAparAhRikI” ॥ iti । atra ca prAguktajAvAlivacanoktA muhUrttAtmikA GawikA grAhyA yogyatvAt na tvekadaRqAtmikA vakzyamARarOhiRAdigrahaRe taTA dfzwatvAcca । tataSca pUrvvoktadvEDe taddvivasIyacaturddaSyapekzayA paradine amAvAsyA kzIyamARA nyUnakAlavyApinI na tu pUrvvAparadivasIyayAvaccaturddaSyapekzayA anupasTiteH । evaM stamBitAvardDamAnayorapi । tadEva pUrvvadarSa eva SrAdDaM । svoktacandrakzayAnuroDAt । yadA triMSaddvaRqAtmakadivase caturddaSyaDikacaturTayAmapUraRe muKyAparAhRIyakiYcinnyUnamuhUrttalABastadApi tadEvetyanena candrakzayAnuroDAt pUrvvadine SrAdDaM na tu muKyAparAhRIyamuhUrttalABe'pi paradine । atra candrakzayaScaturddaSyazwamayAmAt praBfti amAvAsyAsaptamayAmaparyyantamiti vakzyate । tadEvetyeva SravaRAttiTidvEDe KaRqaviSezo niyamyate karmmaRi KaRqAntaravyudAsAya । evaYca yatra pUrvvAparadine vAsaratftIyAMSIyamuKyAparAhRe muhUrttonadarSalABastatrApi pUrvvadina eva SrAdDaM vAsaratftIyAMSacandrakzayAtiSabdasvarasAt । trimuhUrttApItyanuroDAcca । yatra tu pUrvvadine trimuhUrttamAtravyApinyamAvAsyA paradine tftIyAMSamuhUrttavyApinI satI kzIyamARA tatra paradine candrakzayABAve'pi muKyAparAhRalABAt SrAdDam । anyaTA, -- “yadA caturdaSIyAmaM turIyamanupUrayet” । iti viSezABiDAnaM vyarTaM syAt ॥ * ॥ aTa “yatra pUrvvAhe SrAdDaM tatra yadahastveva candramA na dfSyeta tAmamAvAsyAM kurvvIta” iti goBilaviroDaH । taTAviDacaturdaSIyuktAmAvAsyAyAH sinIvAlItvena prAtaScandradarSanAt । tatrAha saeva । “yaduktaM yadahastveva darSanaM neti candramAH । tatkzayApekzayA jYeyaM kzIRe rAjani cetyapi” ॥ “yadahastveva candramA na dfSyeta tAmamAvAsyAM kurvvIta” iti yadgoBilasUtraM taccandrakzayABiprAyikam । anyaTA goBilIyatAdfSasUtrAntareRa saha pOnaruktyApatteH । tasmAt praTamasUtraM kuhUparaM tacca vardDamAnApakze niyataM । kzIRAstamBitayostu yaTAyogyamanusaraRIyam । evaYca “yadahastveva candramA na dfSyeta tAmamAvAsyAM kurvvIta” iti SrutiretatsamAnArTakaM SrutyantaraM vA tadapi vardDamAnAdiparaM na tu kAtyAyanavacanAttatra kzayalakzaRA kalpatarupraBftiBiruktAyuktA । “SrutismftiviroDe tu Srutireva garIyasi” । iti viroDAt । kzIRa iti kAtyAyanena mayA yat kzIRe rAjanItyuktaM tadapi kzayABiprAyakam । aTEvaM dfSyamAne'pyekadA iti yadgoBilasya sUtrAntaraM tadvyarTam । “yadahastveva” ityAdi dvitIyasUtraprAptatiTeH sinIvAlItvenEva candradarSanaprApterityata Aha sa eva । “yaccoktaM dfSyamAne'pi taccaturdaSyapekzayA । amAvAsyAM pratIkzeta tadante vApi nirvvapet” ॥ dfSyamAne'pyekadeti yaduktaM taccaturddaSyAM SrAdDAya pUrvvasUtramamAvAsyApadopAdAnAccandrakzaye satyamamAvAsyAvizayaM । idaM punaritTamBatacaturddaSIvizayamiti SrAdDavivekaH । tat kimamAvAsyAvaccaturddaSItyatrAha amAvAsyAM pratIkzeta uBayatiTiprAptO SrAdDAyAmAvAsyA pratIkzaRIyA । yatra pUrvvadine divA sArdDvamuhUrttamAtre amAvAsyA paradine ca sArdDvadaSamamuhUrttamAtre tatra coBayadine SrAdDayogyAmAvAsyA na prApyate tatra tadanta caturddaSyante nirvvapet dadyAt ॥ * ॥ atrEva vizaye sAgniniragnyorvviSezamAha kAlamADavIye jAbAliH । “aparAhRadvayAvyApI yadi darSastiTikzaye । AhitAgneH sinIvAlI niragnyAdeH kuhUrmmatA” ॥ AdiSabdAdanupanItaSUdrayorgrahaRaM ॥ * ॥ kzayamAha kAtyAyanaH । “azwame'MSe caturddaSyAH kzIRo Bavati candramAH । amAvAsyAzwamAMSe ca tataH kila BavedaRuH” ॥ caturddaSyazwame yAme candramAH kzIRa caturTaBAgonakalAvaSizwo Bavati । “atrendurAdyaprahare'vatizWate” ityAdisvarasAt । amAvAsyAzwame yAme cARurBavati punarutpadyate kiletyAgamavArttAyAM tena amAvAsyAyAH saptame yAme kftsnakzaya ityavagamyate । “tataScAntyakalAvayavanASotpattireva kzayaH sA ca sUkzmatAyAM vinASe'pyastIti” SrAdDavivekaH ॥ utpattirAdyakzaRasambanDaH । tena binASasyAnantatve'pi nAtivyAptiH ॥ * ॥ atra viSezamAha saeva । “AgrahAyaRyamAvAsyA taTA jyEzWasya yA Bavet । viSezamAByAM bruvate candracAravido janAH” ॥ AByAmiti lyablope paYcamI ime prApyetyarTaH । candracAravido jyotirvvidaH । atra pOrRamAsyAntamAsa iti pariSizwaprakASaH ॥ atra tIjaM brahmapurARIyatiTikftyaM । taTA ca SrAdDamaDikftya brahmapurARaM । “payomUlaPalEH SAkEH kfzRapakza ca sarvvadA” । atra kfzRapakze caturddaSIvyatiriktAyAM yasyAM kasyAYcit tiTO SrAdDaviDAnAdamAvAsyApi laByata iti ॥ * ॥ ko viSezEtyatrAha sa eva । “atrendurAdye prahare'vatizWate caturTaBAgonakalAvaSizwaH । tadanta eva kzayameti kftsnamevaM jyotiScakravido vadanti” ॥ atra mAsadvaye amAvAsyAyAM caturTaBAgonakalAvaSizwaH caturTaBAgonA yA kalA tayAvaSizwaH kalABAgatrayamAtraH sannAdye prahare'vatizWate । arTAt caturddaSyazwamayAme kzayAramBa iti । tadanta eva amAvAsyAntayAma eva kzayaM kftsnameti । anyatrAmAvAsyA saptamayAma iti viSezaH । tena mArgaSIrzajyEzWayoruBayadine candrakzayalABe yadyapi yadA caturddeSIyAmamiti vacanAt pUrvvadine eva SrAdDaM prApnoti taTApi tadvacanaM candrakzayAnuroDamUlamiti । kftsnakzayAnuroDAt kzIRAyAmapi paratrAparAhRalABe SrAdDaM anyaTEtadviSezABiDAnaM vyarTaM syAt ॥ * ॥ atrApi viSezAntaramAha sa eva । yasminnabde dvAdaSEkaSca yavyastasmiMstrftIyayA paridfSyo nopajAyeta । yavyo mAsaH । tftIyayA mAtrayA caturTaBAgonakalayA paridfSyaScandro na Bavati kintu tadaDikanyUnakalayeti । tena malamAsayutAbde anyamAsavadanayorapi caturddaSyantayAmAdi darSasaptamayAmaparyyantaM kzaya iti । malamAsayutAbdastu ekasmAnmalamAsAdabdadvayAnantarAbdastftIye'bde malamAsasyAvaSyamBAvAditi ॥ * ॥ candrakzayAnurudDaM kzIRApakzamupasaMharati sa eva । “evaM cAraM candramaso viditvA kzIRe tasminnaparAhRe ca dadyAt” । evaM cAraM gativiSezaM ॥ * ॥ stamBitAyAM vyavasTAmAha sa eva । “sammiSrA yA caturddaSyA amAvAsyABavet kvacit । KarvvitAM tAM viduH kecidupeDvamiti cApare” ॥ kzIRAyAH pUrvvamuktatvAt । vardDvamAnAyASca vakzyamARatvAt asya vacanasya stamBitAparatvaM । KarvvitAM nIcAM pitflokaprApaRAnarhAM kecit yajurvvedinaH । apare fgvedinaH tAmeva upeDvamupagacCata SrAdDAyeti SezaH । upeDvamityatra gatADvAmitipAWe gataH prAptaH pitflokaprApaRAya aDvA anayeti gatADvA praSastetyarTaH । “tasmAcCandogA uBayAnuroDAdicCAta uBayAdaraM kurvvanti” iti kAtyAyanasvarasaH ॥ * ॥ vyaktamAha laGuhArItaH । “trimuhUrttApi karttavyA pUrvvA darSA ca bahvfcEH । kuhUraDvaryyuBiH kAryyA yaTezwaM sAmagItiBiH” ॥ atra trimuhUrttetyupAdAnAt stamBitAyAMH pUrvvadine trimuhUrttamAtralABe'pi bahvfcAnAM SrAdDaM । na tu muKyAparAhRalABAdapi paradine । sAmagAnAM tatrApyaniyamaH । etAdfgvizaya eva umayatrAparAhRAlABe'pIyaM vyavasTeti SrAdDavivekaH ॥ muKyAparAhRasya ekadinamAtralABe'pyuBayadinAlABAt ॥ ॥ * ॥ vardDvamAnAyAM vyavasTAmAha kAtyAyanaH । “vardDvamAnAmamAvAsyAM lakzayedapare'hani । yAmAMstrInaDikAn vApi pitfyajYastato Bavet” ॥ yAmAMstrIniti pUrvvadivasIyayAmatrayanyUnacaturddaSyapekzayA । aTEvaM vAsaratftIyAMSAnuroDena SrAdDaviDAnAt kaTamamAvAsyASrAdDe paryudastarAtryAdItarakAlaparigrahaH । satyaM । tiTidvEDe kzIRAdiBedena KaRqaviSezaparigrahAya vAsaratftIyAMSApekzA anyaToBayadine vAsaratftIyAMSAprAptO SrAdDalopApatteH । prAguktaniragnyAdeH kuhUrmmatetyasya nirvvizayatApatteSca ataH paryyudastetarakAlasyApi parigrahaH । yadA tu pUrvvAparaKaRqayoranyatarasyEva parigrahastadA yaTAyogyaM tatrEva sAyAhnamuhUrttadvayaparyyudastetarakAlakutapAdimuhUrttapaYcakarOhiRAdimuhUrttacatuzwayavAsaratftIyAMSIyAparAhRamuhUrttadvayakAlAH । yaTAkramamApatsAmAnyapraSastapraSastatara-praSastatamatvena jYeyAH । evamaKaRqatiTAvapi nAtisanDyAsamIpata iti pUrvvoktatvAt । “sAyAhnastrimuhUrttaH syAt SrAdDaM tatra na kArayet” । iti matsyapurARAt । “rAtrOSrAdDaM na kurbbIta rAkzasIkIrttitA hi sA । sanDyayoruBayoScEva sUryye cEvAcirodite” ॥ iti manuvacanAByAM । “UrdDvaM muhUrttAt kutapAt yanmUhUrttacatuzwayaM । muhUrttapaYcakaM vApi svaDABavanamizyate” ॥ iti matsyapurARAnmuhUrttapaYcakamityatra kutapAditi lyablope paYcamI kutapamAraByetyarTaH । tatastenEva । “aparAhRe tu samprApte aBijidrOhiRodaye । yadatra dIyate jantostadakzayamudAhftaM” ॥ ityuktaM । “pUrvvAhRo vE devAnAM maDyaM dinaM manuzyARAM aparAhRaH pitFRAM” । iti SrutiH । vAsarasya tftIyAMSa iti kAtyAyanavacanaM । “sAyAhnastrimuhUrttaH syAt SrAdDaM tatra na kArayet” ityezAmekavAkyatvAt a: अमूल, --लक — a. 1 Rootless(lit.); पशवोऽमूला ओषधयो मूलिन्यः Śat. Br.; (fig.) without basis or support, baseless, groundless. --2 Without authority; not being in the original; नामूलं लिख्यते किंचित् Malli. --3 Without material cause, as the Pradhāna of the Sāṃkhyas; मूलं मूलाभावादमूलं. --4 Not fixed in the earth, moving. --ला N. of a plant (अग्निशिखा).

disease, L.

a: अम — a. Unripe (as fruit). --मः 1 Going. --2 Pressure, weight; strength, power (बलं). --3 Fright, terror. --4 Sickness, disease. --5 A servant, follower, an attendant. --6 Vital air, life-wind (प्राण). --7 This, self. --8 Unmeasured state. --मा 1 Soul. --2 Unmeasured state.

a: अमधव्य — a. Not sweet, not worthy of the sweetness of Soma.

अ-मध्यस्थ mfn. not indifferent.

a: अमंद — a. 1 Not slow or dull, active, intelligent; M. 2. 8. --2 Sharp, strong, violent (wind &c.). --3 Not little, much, excessive, great, violent; अमंदमददुर्दिन U. 5. 5; अमंदमिलदिंदिरे निखिलमाधुरीमंदिरे Bv. 4. 1; ˚दष्टौष्ठकरावधूननं Ki. 8. 6 violently bit. --दः N. of a tree.

अमंगल --ल्य — a. 1 Inauspicious, evil, ill; R. 12. 43; ˚अभ्यासरतिं Ku. 5. 65; अमंगल्यं शीलं तव भवतु नामैकमखिलं Puṣpadanta. --2 Unlucky, unfortunate. --लः The castor-oil tree (एरंड). --लं Inauspiciousness, illluck; evil; oft. used in dramatic literature; शांतं पापं प्रतिहतममंगलं; cf. God forbid.
अमंड — a. 1 Without decoration or ornaments. --2 Without froth or scum (as boiled rice). --डः The castor oil tree (एरंड).

अमंत्र, --त्रक — a. 1 Not accompanied by Vedic verses, not requiring the repetition of Vedic texts, as a ceremony &c.; Ms. 3. 121, 2. 66. --2 Not entitled to Vedic verses, such as a Śūdra, a female &c.; Ms. 9. 18. --3 Not knowing Vedic texts; अव्रतानाममंत्राणां 12. 114. --4 Not accompanied by the use of spells or incantations, as a cure &c.; अनया कथमन्यथावलीढा न हि जीवंति जना मनागमंत्राः Bv. 1. 111. --Comp. --तंत्र a. without the use of spells or the magical feats attendant on them, without the use of magical arts; Pt. 1. 70. --विद् a. Not knowing Vedic hymns.
अमंतु — a. Ved. 1 Unwise, foolish. --2 Guiltless, innocent. --3 Despising.

a: अमर — a. [मृ-पचाद्यच् न. त.] Undying, immortal, imperishable; अजरामरवत् प्राज्ञो विद्यामर्थं च साधयेत् H. Pr. 3, Ms. 2. 148. --रः 1 A god, deity. --2 N. of a Marut. --3 N. of a plant (स्नुहीवृक्ष). --4 Quicksilver. --5 Gold. --6 A species of pine. --7 The number 33 (that being the number of Gods). --8 N. of Amarasiṃha, see below; of of a mountain. --9 Mystical signification of the syllable उ. --10 A heap of bones. --रा 1 The residence of Indra (cf. अमरावती). --2 The naval string; umbilical cord. --3 The womb. --4 A house-post (स्थूणा). --5 N. of several plants; इंद्रवारुणी, वटी, महानीली, घृतकुमारी, स्नुही, गुडूची, दूर्वा. --री The same as अमरा. --Comp. --अंगना, --स्त्री a celestial nymph, heavenly damsel; मुषाण रत्नानि हरामरांगनाः Śi. 1. 51. --अद्रिः ‘mountain of the gods’, N. of the mountain Sumeru. --अधिपः, --इंद्रः, ईशः, ईश्वरः, पतिः, भर्ता, राजः &c. ‘the lord of the gods’, epithets of Indra; sometimes of Śiva and Viṣṇu also. --आचार्यः, --गुरुः, --इज्यः ‘preceptor of the gods’, epithets of Bṛhaspati. --आपगा, --तटिनी, --सरित् f. the heavenly river, an epithet of the Ganges; ˚तटिनीरोधसि वसन् Bh. 3. 123. --आलयः the abode of the gods, heaven. --उत्तम a. the best of the gods. --उपम a. God-like. --कंटकं N. of that part of the Vindhya range which is near the source of the river Narmadā. --कोटः ‘the fortress of the immortals’, N. of the capital of a (modern) Rajaput state. --कोशः, --षः N. of the most popular Sanskrit lexicon called after the author अमरसिंह. --जः N. of a tree, a kind of खदिर. --तरुः, --दारुः {1} a celestial tree, a tree in the paradise of Indra; अमरुतरुकुसुमसौरभसेवनसंपूर्णसकलकामस्य Bv. 1. 28. {2} देवदारु. {3} the wishyielding tree. --द्विजः a Brāhmaṇa who lives by attending a temple or idol; or one who superintends a temple. --पुरं {1} the residence of the gods, celestial paradise. {2} N. of various other towns. --पुष्पः, --ष्पकः {1} N. of several plants (केतक, चूत). {2} N. of a kind of grass. {3} the wish-yielding tree (कल्पवृक्ष). --पुष्पिका N. of a plant (अधःपुष्पीवृक्ष); a kind of anise. --प्रख्य, --प्रभ a. like an immortal. --प्रभुः one of the 1000 names of Viṣṇu. --माला N. of a lexicon. --रत्नं a crystal. --लोकः the world of the gods, heaven; ˚ता heavenly bliss; तेषु सम्यग्वर्तमानो गच्छत्यमरलोकतां Ms. 2. 5. --वल्लरी N. of a plant ( आकाशवल्ली). --सिंहः N. of the author of Amarakoṣa; he was a Jaina and is said to have been one of the 9 gems that adorned the court of king Vikramāditya. The dates of many of these ‘gems’ are still doubtful, but if he was really a contemporary of Kālidāsa, he could not have lived later than the 7th century which is usually assigned to Kālidāsa as the terminus ad quem.

s: strI, (ambu tadvarzaRaM vAcayati sUcayati, vac + Ric + aR, upapadasamAsaH, NIp .) ftumatI pfTvI । yaTA, -- “yadvAre yatkAle miTunasaMkramaRaM BUtaM tadvArAByantare tAvatkAlAvaDi viMSatyAdidaRqADikadinatrayamambuvAcI । tatrADyayanaM vIjavapanaM na kAryyaM । sarpaBayopaSamanAya dugDaM peyaM” । iti kftyatattvaM ॥ * ॥ apica । jyotize । “rajoyuk kzmAmbuvAcI ca rOdrAdyapAdage ravO । tasyAM pAWo vIjavApo nAhiBIrdugDapAnataH ॥ mfgaSirasi nivftte rOdrapAde'mbuvAco ftumati Kalu pfTvI varjjayet trIRyahAni । yadi vapati kfzARaH kzetramAsAdya vIjaM na Bavati PalaBAgI SasyacARqAlapAkaH” ॥ rajoyuk kzmA ftumatI pfTvI । matsyasUkte । “DaraRyAmftumatyAYca BUmikampe taTEva ca । antarAgamane cEva vidyAM nEva paWedbuDaH” ॥ jyotize । “yasmin vAre sahasrAMSuryatkAle BiTunaM vrajet । ambuvAcI BavennityaM punastatkAlavArayoH” ॥ idantu prAyikaM । iti tityAditattvaM ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “yadArdrarkzaM samAdAya BAnormmanmaTagAmitA । punastatsTenamAdAya yajanaM tridinaM tyajet ॥ kAmyanEmittikaYcEva yAtrAM mantrakriyAntaTA । ftumatyAM na kurvvIta pUrvvasaNkalpitAdfte ॥ na kuryyAt KananaM BUmeH sUcyagreRApi SaNkari । vIjAnAM vapanaYcEva caturvviMSatiyAmakaM ॥ pramAdAdvapanaM kftvA gAvastatra pracArayet । kfcCraM kuryyAt tatkzaRAcca KananAttilakAYcanaM” ॥ iti matsyasUkte mahAtantre 58 pawalaH ॥ * ॥ aparaYca । “ravO rudrAdyapAdasTe BUmeH saMjAyate rajaH । tasmAddinatrayaM yAvat vIjavApaM parityajet ॥ catvAriMSalliptikazaqBAgayuto raviryadA Bavati । tatrAmbuvAcI jYeyA SivarkzapAdasTito yAvat ॥ digBAgaSUnyalipto gaRitena Bavati raviryadA sAptaH । sa Bavati nirguRakAlo dvitIyapAdASrayAdrOdre” ॥ “na svADyAyaM vazawkAraM na devapitftarpaRaM । halAnAM vAhanaYcEva vIjAnAM vapanaM taTA” ॥ iti rAjamArttaRqaH ॥ * ॥ atra pAkanizeDo yaTA, -- “yatino vratinaScEva viDavA ca dvijastaTA । ambuvAcIdine cEva pAkaM kftvA na Bakzayet ॥ svapAkaM parapAkaM vA ambuvAcIdine taTA । BakzaRaM nEva karttavyaM cARqAlAnnasamaM smftaM” ॥ iti saMvatsarapradIpe vizRurahasyaM ॥
v: strI ambu tadvarzaRaM vAcayati sUcayati baca--Ric--aR upa॰ sa॰ NIp । ArdrAdyapAdasTaravikAlikaBUmO “ArdrAdyAdi viSAKAntaM ravicAreRa varzati” ityuktestasyA vfzwisUcakatvam । tatkAle hi BUmerantargatarajoyogEtyatastasyAstaTAtvam । yaToktam “rajoyukkzmAmbuvAcI ca rOdrAdyapAdage ravO” jyoti॰ । miTunarASirhi mfgaSiraHSezArdDArdrApAdacatuzka punarvasupAdatrayAtmakaH । tatra mfgaSirasi Bukte yadA ArdrAyAH praTamaprAdopaBogArTaMravirgacCati tadA pfTvI ftumatI Bavati taccamiTune 6 । 40 catvAriMSatkalADikazaqaMSAnatItya ArdrAdyapAdAvaDi yAvattizWati tAvat । yaToktaM rAjamA॰ । “ravO rOdrAdyapAdasTe BUmeH saMjAyaterajaH” ityupakramya । “catvAriMSalliptika zaqBAgayutoraviryadA Bavati । tatrAmbuvAcI jYeyASivarkzapAde sTito yAvat । digBAgaSUnya liptogaRitena Bavati raviryadA sApta” iti । tatra ca varjryAni “na svADyAyaM vazawkAraM na devapitftarpaRam ॥ halAnAM vAhanaYcEva vIjAnAM vapanaM taTA” rAjamA॰ । “tasyAM pAWovIjavAponAhiBIrdugvapAnataH” jyo॰ । yadA rdrarkzaM samAdAya BAnormanmaTagAmitA । punastatsTenamAdAya yajanaM tridinaM tyajet । kAmyaM nEmittikaM cEva yAtrAM mantrakriyAM taTA । ftumatyAM na kurvvIta pUrvvasaNkalpitAdfte । na kuryyAt KananaM BUmeH sUcyagreRApi SaNkari! । matsya sU॰ । “yatinovratinaScEva viDAvA ca dvijastaTA । ambuvAcIdine cEva pAkaM kftvA na Bakzayet । svapAkaM parapAkaM vA ambuvAcIdine taTA । BakzaRaM nEva karttavyaM caRqAlAnnamayaM smftam” vizRurahasyam ।

a: अमृत — a. 1 Not dead; अमृते जारजः कुंडः Ak. --2 Immortal; अपाम सोमममृता अभूम Rv. 8. 48. 3; U. 1. 1; Bg. 14. 27. --3 Imperishable, indestructible, eternal. --4 Causing immortality. --5 Beautiful, agreeable, desired. --तः 1 A god, an immortal, deity. --2 N. of Dhanvantari, physician of the gods; also N. of Indra, of the sun, of Prajāpati, of the soul, Viṣṇu and Śiva. --3 N. of a plant (वनमुद्ग). --4 N. of the root of a plant (वाराहीकंद). --ता 1 Spirituous liquor. --2 N. of various plants; e. g. आमलकी, हरीतकी, गुडूची; मागधी; तुलसी, इंद्रवारुणी, ज्योतिष्मती, गोरक्षदुग्धा; अतिविषा; रक्तत्रिवृत्; दूर्वा, स्थूलमांसहरीतकी. --3 N. of one of the Nāḍīs in the body; Māl. 5. 2. --4 One of the rays of the sun; R. 10. 58. --तं 1 (a) Immortality, imperishable state; न मृत्युरासीदमृतं न तर्हि Rv. 10. 129. 2; Ms. 12. 85. (b) Final beatitude, absolution; तपसा किल्बिषं हंति विद्ययामृतमश्नुते Ms. 12. 104; स श्रिये चामृताय च Ak. --2 The collective body of immortals. --3 (a) The world of immortality, Paradise, Heaven; the power of eternity, immortal light, eternity. --4 Nectar of immortality, ambrosia, beverage of the gods (opp. विष) supposed to be churned out of the ocean; देवासुरैरमृतमंबुनिधिर्ममंथे Ki. 5. 30; विषादष्यमृतं ग्राह्यं Ms. 2. 239; विषमप्यमृतं क्वचिद्भवेदमृतं वा विषमीश्वरेच्छया R. 8. 46; oft. used in combination with words like वाच्, वचनं, वाणी &c; कुमारजन्मामृतसंमिताक्षरं R. 3. 16; आप्यायितोसौ वचनामृतेन Mb.; अमृतं शिशिरे वह्निरमृतं क्षीरभोजनं Pt. 1. 128 the height of pleasure or gratification. --5 The Soma juice. --6 Antidote against poison. --7 The residue or leavings of a sacrifice; (यज्ञशेष) Ms. 3. 285. --8 Unsolicited alms, alms got without solicitation; मृतं स्याद्याचितं भैक्ष्यममृतं स्यादयाचितं Ms. 4. 4-5. --9 Water; अमृताध्मातजीमूत U. 6. 21; अमृतादुन्मथ्यमानात् K. 136; cf. also the formulas अमृतोपस्तरणमसि स्वाहा and अमृतापिधानमसि स्वाहा repeated by Brāhmaṇas at the time of sipping water before the commencement and at the end of meals. --10 A drug. --11 Clari fied butter; अमृतं नाम यत् संतो मंत्रजिह्वेषु जुह्वति Śi. 2. 107. --12 Milk. --13 Food in general. --14 Boiled rice. --15 Any thing sweet, any thing lovely or charming; a sweetmeat. --16 Property. --17 Gold. --18 Quicksilver. --19 Poison. --20 The poison called वत्सनाभ. --21 The Supreme Spirit (ब्रह्म). --22 N. of a sacred place. --23 N. of particular conjunctions of Nakṣatras (lunar asterisms) with week days (वारनक्षत्रयोग) or of lunar days with week days (तिथिवारयोग). --24 The number four. --25 Splendour, light. [cf. Gr. ambrotos, ambrosia; L. immortalis]. --Comp. --अंशुः, --करः, --दीधितिः, --द्युतिः, --रश्मिः &c. epithets of the moon; अमृतदीधितिरेष विदर्भजे N. 4. 104; अमृतांशूद्भव born from the moon; from whom was born the moon, N. of Viṣṇu. --अक्षर a. immortal and imperishable; क्षरं प्रधानममृताक्षरं हरः Śvet. ˚राणि प्रज्ञानानि U. 7. --(रः) {1} clarified butter. {2} a sort of अयः पाक. ˚जः raw sugar, molasses (गुड). --सूः, --सूतिः {1} the moon (distilling nectar). {2} mother of the gods. --सोदरः {1} ‘brother of nectar,’ the horse called उच्चैःश्रवस्. {2} a horse in general. --स्रवः flow of nectar. --(वा) N. of a plant and tree (रुदंती). --स्रुत् a. shedding or distilling nectar; k.v: व्योमयानं विमानोऽस्त्री नारदाद्याः सुरर्षयः। स्यात्सुधर्मा देवसभा पीयूषममृतं सुधा॥
मोक्षे धीर्ज्ञानमन्यत्र विज्ञानं शिल्पशास्त्रयोः। मुक्तिः कैवल्यनिर्वाणश्रेयोनिःश्रेयसामृतम्.।
आपः स्त्री भूम्नि वार्वारि सलिलं कमलं जलम्. पयः कीलालममृतं जीवनं भुवनं वनम्.।
त्रिष्वथ क्रतुकर्मेष्टं पूर्तं खातादि कर्म यत्. अमृतं विघसो यज्ञशेषभोजनशेषयोः॥
द्वे याचितायाचितयोर्यथासंख्यं मृतामृते। सत्यानृतं वणिग्भावः स्यादृणं पर्युदञ्चनम्.।

v: pu॰ amftaM pAti rakzati asureByaH pA--rakzaRe ka । 1 vizRO sahi amftamanTanasamaye asurErhriyamARamamftaM mohinIrUpaM viDAya tAn vaYcayitvA deveByodAnAt tat pAlakaH iti BAgavatI kaTA । “somapo'mftapaH soma” iti vi॰ sa॰ । amftaM pibati pA pAne ka । 2 deve taddarSanena tfptatvAttatpAyitvam amftaSabde dfSyam । 3 amftatulyamaDvAdipAtari tri॰ । “DruvamamftapanAmavAYCayAsAvaDaramasuM maDupastavAjihIte” mAGaH ।
m: अ-मृत—प mfn. drinking nectar
अ-मृत—प m. N. of a Dānava, MBh. i, 2537 N. of Viṣṇu, MBh. xiii.

v: pu॰ amftasya hiraRyasya pakzaH kzayAkAritvAt । 1 vahnO “agnO suvarRRamakzIRam” yA॰ ukteH sarvvadAhakasyApi vahne rna suvarRRanASakatvamityatastasya svarRRapakzatvam । “tasyetAvamftapakzO yAvetAvaBito'gnI” iti Sata॰ brA॰ amataM svarRRamiva pItO pakzAvasya । 1 svarRRavarRRapakze SyenaBede “hiraRyapakzaH SakunoBuraRyumamftaM vE hiraRyamftapakzaH SakunaH” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अ-मृत—पक्ष m. the immortal wing (of sacrificial fire), ŚBr.
अमृत—पक्ष mfn. (= हिरण्य-पक्ष, q.v.) having golden wings, ŚBr.
अ-मृत—प्लवन n. a stream or flow of nectar, Mālatīm.
अ-मृत—प्राशन or अ-मृत—प्राशिन्, m. ‘living on Amṛta’, a god, R.
अ-मृत—प्रभा f. N. of several women, Rājat.
अ-मृत—प्रभ m. N. of a Vidyādhara, Kathās.
अ-मृत—रश्मि m. = -कर, q.v., Kathās.; Bhaṭṭ.

s: strI, (amftavat svAduH raso yasyAH sA, striyAM wAp .) kapiladrAkzA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (pakvAnnaviSezaH ॥ sA ca “tftIyaBAgaKaRqena miSritaM zazwipizwakaM । SuBramIzaddaDiyutaM marddayeddfQapARinA ॥ evaM samudDftaM kftvA sTApayedrajanImitaM । tato'nyasminnahani tu citritaM nistvacEstilEH ॥ viDAyApUpakaM tena tambikAyAM Gfte pacet । tato'mftarasA jAtA vAtahfdbalavardDinI” ॥ iti BAvaprakASe .)
m: अ-मृत—रसा f. dark-coloured grapes, L.

v: pu॰ amftaM rasa iva AsvAdyam । 1 amftarUpe AsvAdye “vimlAnona vimarddane'mftarasaprasyandamADvIkaBUH” kumA॰ । amftasya rasaH sAraH । 2 suDArase “siktA ivAmftarasena muhurjanAnAm” mAGaH । amftaM mokzaH rasa iva yasya । 3 paramAtmani “sa eza sEnDavaGano'mftarasa iti” SrutiH amftasyeva rasa AsvAdo'syAH । 4 kapilAdrAkzAyAM (andarasA) prasidDe 5 pakvAnnaBede ca strI । sA ca “tftIyaBAgaKaMRqena miSritaM zazWipizwakam । SuBramIzaddaDiyutaM marddayeddfQapARinA । evaM samudDitaM kftvA sTApayedrajanImitam । tato'nyamminnahani tu citritaM nistvacEntilEH viDAya pUpakaM tena tambikAyAM Gfte pacet । tato'matarasA jAtA vAtahradbalavardDinI” iti BA॰ pra॰ uktA ।
m: अ-मृत—रस m. nectar, Hit. &c.

v: ” pu॰ amftasya dugDasya sAraH । Gfte । cakradattokte ayaHpAkaBede yaTA “lohasya pAkamaDunA nAgArjjunaSizwamaDidaGnaH ॥ lohArakUwatAmrajakawAhe dfQamfRmaye praRamya Sivam । tadayaH pacedacapalaH kAzWenDanena vahninA mfdunA ॥ nikzipya triPalAjalamfditaM yattat GftaYca dugDaYca । saMcAlya lOhamayyA darvyA lagnaM samutpAWya ॥ mfdumaDyaKaraBAvEH pAkastriviDo'tra vakzyate puMsAm । pittasamIraRaSlezmaprakftInAM maDyamasya samaH ॥ aByaktadarvilohaM suKaduHKasKalanayogi mfdu maDyam । ujJitadarvi KaraM pariBAzante kecidAcAryyAH ॥ anye vihInadarvvIpralepamAKutkarAkftiM bruvate । mfdumaDyamardDacUrRaM sikatApuYjopamantu Karam ॥ tribiDo'pi pAka Idfk sarvezAM guRakfdeva na tu viPalaH । prakftiviSeze sUkzmO guRadozO janayatItyalpam ॥ vijYAya pAkamevaM drAgavatAryya kzitO kzaRAn kiyataH । viSrAmya tatra lohe triPalAdeH prakzipeccUrRam ॥ yadi karpUraprAptirBavati tato vigalite yaduzRatve । curRRIkftamanurUpaM kzipenna vA na yadi tallABaH ॥ pakvaM tadaSmasAraM suciraGftasTityaBAvirukzatve । gIdohanAdiBARqe lOhaBARqABAve sati sTApyam । yadi tu parilputihetorGftamOkzetADikaM tato'nyasmin । BARqe niDAya rakzedBAvyupayogo hyanena mahAn ॥ ayasi virukzIBUte snehastilaGftena sampAdyaH । etattato guRottaramityamunA snehanIyaM tat ॥ atyantakaPaprakfterBakzaRamayaso'munEva saMsanti । kebalamapIdamaSitaM janayatyayaso guRAn kiyataH ॥ amftasAraH” cakra॰ da॰ ।

s: puM, (amftasya sAraH tasmAt jAyate, amftasAra + jan + qaH, upapadasamAsaH .) guqaH । tavarAjodBavaKaRqaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: pu॰ amftAdiva svAdoH sArAt jAyate jana--qa 5 ta॰ । 1 guqe rA॰ ni॰ ।
m: अ-मृत—सार-ज m. ‘produced from the essence of ambrosia’, raw sugar, L.

s: puM, (amftaM tuzAraM sUte, amfta + sU + kvip, upapadasamAsaH .) (amftAn devAn sUte, amfta + sU + kvip, upapadasamAsaH .) candraH । iti hemacandraH ॥ devamAtari strI । amftAnAM devAnAM sUH prasUtiH ॥
v: amftaM dIDitirUpamApyayanaM sUte sU--kvip । candre । amratAn devAn sUte । devamAtari strI ।
m: अ-मृत—सू m. (√ 3. सु), ‘distilling nectar’, the moon, L.

v: strI amftEva samBavati sam BU + ac । guqUcyAm (guluYca) ।

na॰ amftamiva svAdu saMyAvam । pakvAnnaBede । “pacet Gftottame tapte nyaset pakvaM nave Gawe । tato maricacUrRena svaRqacUrRRAvacUrRitam । kuryyAt karpUrasaMyuktaM saMyAva mamftopamam । saMyAvamamftasvAdu pittaGnaM maDuraM smftamiti BA॰ pra॰ ।

m: अ-मृत—सहोदर m. ‘brother of Nectar’, a horse (cf. -बन्धु), L.

s: strI, (sam + BU + BAve ap, amftasya maraRABAvasya rogABAvasya iti yAvat samBava utpattiryasyAH sA, striyAM wAp .) guqUcI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: अ-मृत—सम्भवा f. = -वल्लरी, q.v.
अ-मृत—सम्भव mfn. produced from nectar, MBh. xiii, 7200
अ-मृत—सरस् n. ‘lake of nectar’, N. of a city in the Panjāb (commonly called Amritsar)

s: puM, (amftasya sodaraH sodaryyaH tasya ekasTAnAdutpannatvAt taTAtvaM .) GowakaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (uccEHsravA aSvaH । “surAdevI samutpannA turagaH pARqarastaTA” । iti BArate .)
v: amftasya sodara ekata utpannatvAt । uccEHSravasi aSva । tasyAmftamaTane samudrAdutpannatvAt taTAtvam । surA devI samutpannA turagaH pARqarastaTA” BA॰ A॰ pa॰ । tajjAtIyatvAt GowakamAtre rAjani॰ ।
m: अ-मृत—सोदर m. = -सहोदर.
अ-मृत—स्राव m. a flow or current of water, Sūryas.

s: strI, (sravati iti sru + ap । striyAM wAp । amftasya sravA zazWItatpuruzaH .) rudantIvfkzaH । latAviSezaH । tatparyyAyaH । vfkzAruhA 2 upavallikA 3 GanavallI 4 sitalatA 5 । asyA guRAH । paTyatvaM । IzattiktatvaM । rasAyanatvaM । vraRanASitvaM । vizakuzWAmakAmalASvayaTujayakAritvaYca । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (“uktAmftasravA paTyA IzattiktA rasAyanI । vraRaGnI vizakuzWAmaM kAmalAM SvayaTuM jayet” ॥ iti rAjanirGaRwaH .)
v: strI॰ amftamiva sravati sru--pacAdyac । 1 rudantIlatAyAm । BAve ap 6 ta॰ । 2 amftanizyande pu॰ ।
m: अ-मृत—स्रवा f. N. of a plant, L.
अ-मृत—स्रुत् mfn. (= -द्रव, q.v.), Kum. i, 46; Śiś. ix, 68.
अ-मृत—ता f. immortality, L.
a: अमृतता, --त्वं — Immortality; Rv. 10. 90. 2; Ms. 6. 60.

s: strI, (amftasya pIyUzasya taraNgiRI nadIva .) jyotsnA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI amftasya suDAyA tuzArasya taraNgiRI nadIva । jyotsnAyAm rAja॰ ni॰ ।
m: अ-मृत—तरङ्गिणी f. ‘having nectar-waves’, moon-light, L.

v: na॰ amftasyAmaraRasya BAvaH tva । 1 mokze । “tyAge nEke amftatvamAnaSuH” SrutiH “kaScidDIraH pratyagAtmAnamEkzadAvfttacakzuramftatvamicCan” ka॰ u॰ । “amftatvamamaraRaDarmmatvam BA॰ “ahiMsayA ca BUtAnAmamftatvAya kalpate” iti manuH “ABUtasaMplavasTAnamamftatvaM hi BAzyate” iti vizRu॰ pu॰ ukte 2 mahAkalpAvasTAyitve ca ।

m: अ-मृत—तेजस् m. N. of a Vidyādhara prince, Kathās.

v: strI nagaRapayoDararucirA kusumavirAjitasukurA । vasulaGudIrGayugalakA Bavati saKe'mftatilakA ityuktalakzaRe daSAkzarapAdake varRavfttaBede “tvaritagatiSca najanagErityuktatvaritagatilakzaRAkrAntatvAt tasyA eva nAmAntaram ।

m: अ-मृत—त्व n. = -ता, RV.; AV.; VS. &c.
अ-मृत—वाका f. N. of a bird, ŚBr. x.

v: tri॰ amftamiva vAko vacanaM yasya । 1 amftatulya vacane “amftavAkA vayasAM sA kzipraSyenaM janayati” Sata॰ brA॰

s: strI, (amftavat vallI, tasyA roganASakatvAt taTAtvaM .) guqUcI । iti ratnamAlA ॥

m: अ-मृत—वल्लरी or अ-मृत—वल्ली [Suśr.], f. the creeping plant Cocculus Cordifolius.

v: amftenApyAyitaM vapurasya । 1 candre sa hi kfzRapakze vahnyAdiBiH kalAnAmekEkaSaH BakzaRe'pi punaH yajYaSizwarUpAmftenApyAyyate । yaToktaM kAlamADazIye somotpattivAkyena “praTamAM pibate vahnirdvitIyAM pibate raviH । viSve devAstftIyAntu caturTAM salilADipaH । paYcamIM tu vazawkAraH zazWIM pibati vAsavaH । saptanImfzayodivyA azwamImajaekapAt । navamIM kfzRapakzasya yamaH prASnAtivE kalAm । daSamIM pibate vAyuH pibatyekAdaSImumA । dvAdaSIM pitaraH sarve samaM prASnanti BAgaSaH । trayodaSIM DanADyakzaH kuveraH pibate kalAm । caturddaSIM paSupatiH paYcadaSIM prajApatiH । nizpItaSca kalASezaScandramA na prakASate । kalA zoqaSikAyA tu sA tvapo viSate tadA । amAyAM tu sadA soma ozaDoH pratipadyate । tamozaDigataM gAvaH pibantya psugataYca yat । tatkzIramamftaM BUtvA mantraBUtaM dvijAtiBiH । hutamagnizu yajYezu punarApyAyate SaSI । dine dine kalAvfdDiH pOrRamAsyAM tu pUrRatA” iti । yadyapi jyotize kfzRapakze sUryyamaRqale praveSa eva uktastaTApi tattaddivase candrakalABakzaRavat vahnyAdInAM tfptirityetatparatvaM somotpattivAkyasya devAnAm asmadAdInAmiva BojanasyAsidDeH tfptimAtrADAyakatvena tadBogyatvam “na vE devA annanti pibanti etardavAmftaM dfzwvA tfpyanti” CA॰ u॰ uktestaTAvagamyate ityaviroDaH । anaSvaraKarUpe vizROH “amftASo'mftavapuH” vizRusa॰ ।
m: अ-मृत—वपुस् m. ‘of immortal form’, N. of Viṣṇu, MBh. xiii
of Śiva.
अ-मृत—वर्धन m. N. of a poet (quoted in Śārṅgadhara's anthology).
अ-मृत—वर्षिन् mfn. giving a shower of nectar, Śak. (v.l.)
अ-मृत—विन्दूपनिषद् See -बिन्द्˚ऊपनिषद्.
अ-मृत—यज्ञ m. a sacrifice for obtaining immortality, Kāṭh.

v: pu॰ amftAKyoyogaH । jyotizokte । tiTivArAdiyogaBede sa cAmftaSabde uktaH ।
m: अ-मृत—योग m. (in astrol.) a certain Yoga.
अ-मृत—योनि m. the home of the immortals, ŚBr.
अमृतेश m. ‘lord of the immortals’, N. of Śiva, PadmaP.

v: pu॰ amfte jale Sete SI--ac aluk sa॰ । vizRO tasya pralaye jalaSAyitvAt taTAtvam ।
m: अमृते-शय m. ‘lying on Amṛta’, N. of Viṣṇu, Hariv.
a: अमृतेशयः — N. of Viṣṇu(sleeping in waters).

m: अमृतेश्वर m. = अमृतेस, q.v., Rājat.
N. of a medicament, Bhpr.
अमृतेष्टका f. a burnt or baked (and therefore imperishable) brick (used for the sacrificial altar), ŚBr.

s: klI, (amftaM vizamiva udBavati kfzRavarRatvAt, ud + BU + ap .) tutTaM । KarparItutTaM । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: na॰ amftaM vizamiva nIlavarRatayA udBavati ud + BU--ac । KarparItutTe (tute) tutTaBede । amftaM mftyuYjayaM SivamudBavate prApnoti svasADyArcanAvattvAt । vilvavfkze । “amf todBavaH SrIvfkzaH SaNkarasya sadA priyaH” taddAnamantraH ।
m: अमृतोद्भव or अमृतोपम, n. = अमृतोत्पन्न n. q.v., L.
अमृतोदन m. N. of a son of Siṃhahanu, and uncle of Śākyamuni.
अमृतोपस्तरण n. water sipped as a substratum for the nectar-like food, ĀśvGṛ. & MānGṛ.
an imperishable substratum, TĀr. (cf. अमृतापिधान).

s: strI, (amftaM maDu utpannaM yasyAH sA, “jAtikAlasuKAdiByo nizWAyAH paravacanamiti nizWAyAH paranipAtaH” .) makzikA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI amftamiva svAdu maDu utpannaM yasyAH 5 ta॰ । makzikAyAM rAjani॰ ।
m: अमृतोत्पन्ना f. a fly, L.

s: klI, (amftaM vizamiva utpannaM nIlavarRatvAt .) KarparItutTaM । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: na॰ amftaM vizamiva utpannam nIlavarRatvAt । KarparItutTe rAjani॰ ।
m: अमृतोत्पन्न n. impure carbonate of zinc, L.
अमृतोत्पत्ति f. the production of the Amṛta (N. of a chapter of the first book of the Rāmāyaṇa, relating how the Amṛta was obtained by the gods).
अ-मृत्-पात्र-प mfn. not drinking from a clay vessel, MaitrS.

v: pu॰ aBAve na॰ । 1 mftyuvigame । nAsti mftyuryasmAt । 2 mftyuhetuBinne tri॰ । “svaBAnave Sravo'mftyu Dukzata” f॰ 6, 48, 12 “amftyu amaraRahetuM Sravo'nnam” BA॰ । mftyurvinASo nAstyasya । 3 vinASaSUnye vizRO “amftyuH sarvvadfk siMhaH” vizRusahasranAma ।
m: अ-मृत्यु m. non-death, immortality, ŚBr. xiii; KauṣUp.
अ-मृत्यु mfn. immortal, RV.
a: अमृत्यु — a. 1 Immortal; causing immortality. --त्युः Not death, immortality. --2 N. of Viṣṇu.

v: avya॰ na॰ ta॰ । miTyABinne satye । “yaTA vfkzo vana spatistaTEva puruzo'mfzA” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अ-मृषा ind. not falsely, certainly, surely, ŚBr. xiv; BhP.
a: अमृषा — ind. Not falsely, truly.

m: अ-मृषा—भाषि-त्व n. speaking truthfully (one of the qualities of a good spy) Comm. on Kir.
अमृषोद्य n. true speech, Bhaṭṭ. vi, 57.
अ-मृष्ट mfn. (√ मृज्), not rubbed or washed, unclean, R. (v.l.)
a: अमृष्ट — a. Unrubbed. --Comp. --मृज a. of unimpaired purity.

m: अ-मृष्ट—भुज् or अ-मृष्ट—भोजिन्, mfn. not eating delicate food or dainties (cf. 1. मृष्ट), R. i, 6, 8 (i, 6, 11 ed. Bomb.)
अ-मृष्ट—मृज mfn. of unimpaired purity, Bhaṭṭ.
अ-मृष्यमाण mfn. (√ मृष्), not-bearing, not tolerating, ŚBr. xii, &c.

v: tri॰ na॰ ta॰ । saMkIrRaBinne pfTagBUte । “tadvA amiSrameva vasUnAM prAtaH savanam” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अ-मिश्र mfn. ‘unmixed’, exclusive (i.e. without participation of others), ŚBr.
a: अमिश्र, --श्रित — a. Unmixed, unblended; not shared by others.

m: अ-मिश्रणीय mfn. immiscible, L.
अ-मिश्रण n. = अ-यावन, q.v. Comm. on RPrāt.
अ-मिश्रित mfn. unmixed, unblended.
अ-मिथित mfn. not reviled
unprovoked, RV. viii, 45, 37.
a: अमिथित — a. Ved. Not reviled, not provoked.

m: अ-मिथुन mfn. (pl.) not both sexes promiscuously, ĀśvGṛ.

v: avya॰ viroDe na॰ ta॰ । miTyABinne satye “tAmUcatuste priyamapyamiTyA” raGuH ।
m: अ-मिथ्या ind. not falsely, truthfully, Ragh.
a: अमिथ्या — adv. Not falsely, truly; तामूचतुस्ते प्रियमप्यमिथ्या R. 14. 6.

m: अ-मिथ्या-√ कृ to make true, confirm, MBh.
अ-मिलातक = अ-मलातक, q.v.
a: अमिलातकं — Globe-amaranth.

v: tri॰ cu॰ ama--roge hrasvaH ini । rogiRi ।
m: अमिन् mfn. (fr. 1. अम), sick, L.
a: अमिन् — a. Sick, diseased.

v: tri॰ mi--kzepe bA॰ karmaRi naN na॰ ta॰ । akzepaRIye ahiMsye “uta dvivarhA aminaH sahoBiH” f॰ 6, 19, 1 । “aminaH ahiMsanIyaH” BA॰ ।
m: अमिन mfn. impetuous, RV. vi, 19, 1 and x, 116, 4.
अमिन See √ अम्.
a: अमिन — a. Ved. Inviolable( अहिंस्य); immense (?).

m: अ-मिनत् mfn. (√ 1. मि), not violating or transgressing, not altering, RV.
अ-मिनत् f. (Ved. du. ˚अती) unalterable, RV. iv, 56, 2.
a: अमिनत् — a. Ved. Not hurting; unhurt.

m: अमिताभ, (आस्), m. pl. ‘of unmeasured splendour’, N. of certain deities in the eighth Manvantara, VP.
अमिताभ, (अस्), m. sg. = अमितायुस्. (see MWB. 183 &c.)
अ-मि—˚ताशना f. ‘immoderate in eating’, N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda, MBh.

v: pu॰ amitamaSnAti saMhAramamaye aSa--lyu । sarvaBakzake parameSvare । “yasya brahma ca kzatraYca uBe Bavata odane mftfryasyopasecanam” iti SruteH “attA carAcaragrahaRAt” iti SA॰ sUtrAcca tasya sarvaBakzakatvam । 2 vizRO ca “vegavAnamitASanaH” vizRusa॰ ।

m: अ-मिताक्षर mfn. not containing a fixed number of syllables, Nir.; RPrāt.
अमितात्मन् mfn. of an immense mind, MBh. iii, 11924.
अ-मि—˚तायुर्-ध्यान-सूत्र n. N. of a Buddhist Sūtra.

v: tri॰ moGo nizPalaH na॰ ta॰ । 1 saPale, 2 avyarTe ca । “amoGAsu patantezu Darmmapotena santara” BA॰ SA॰ pa॰ । “yadamoGamapAmantaruptaM vIjamaja! tvayA” kumA॰ DanuzyamoGaM samaDatta sAyakam” “amoGAH pratigfhRantAvarGAnupadamASizam” iti ca raGuH । 3 nadaBede pu॰ । 4 pawolalatAyAM, haritakyAM 5 viqaNge ca strI । 6 vizRO pu॰ “amoGaH puRqarIkAkzaH” vizRu॰ sa॰ “satyakAmaH satyasaNkalpa” iti SruteH avitaTasaNkalpatvAttasya taTAtvam ।
m: अ-मोघ mf(आ)n. unerring, unfailing, not vain, efficacious, succeeding, hitting the mark, productive, fruitful
अ-मोघ m. the not erring, the not failing, ŚBr.
अ-मोघ m. a shark, L.
N. of Śiva
of Viṣṇu, MBh. xiii
of Skanda, MBh. iii, 14632
of a minister of an Asura king at war with Kārttikeya, SkandaP.
of a river, L.
a: अमोघ — a. 1 Unfailing, reaching the mark; धनुष्यमोघं समधत्त बाणं Ku. 3. 66; R. 3. 53; 12. 97; कामिलक्ष्येष्वमोधैः Me. 73. --2 Unerring, infallible (words, boon &c.); अमोधाः प्रतिगृह्णंतावर्घ्यानुपदमाशिषः R. 1. 44; युतममोघतया Ki. 6. 40. --3 Not vain or useless, efficacious, fruitful, productive; यदमोघमपामंतरुप्तं बीजमज त्वया Ku. 2. 5; so ˚बलं, ˚शक्ति, ˚वीर्य, ˚क्रोध &c. --घः 1 Not failing or erring, unerringness. --2 N. of Viṣṇu (or of Śiva according to some). --3 N. of a river. --घा 1 N. of the plant पाटलां (Mar. पाडळी) (the trumpet flower). --2 N. of another plant विडंग (Mar. वावडिंग) the seed of which is used as a vermifuge, and hence also called कृमिघ्न. --3 = पथ्या. --4 N. of a spear or शक्ति. --5 N. of Śiva's wife. --6 Mystical name of the conjunct consonant क्ष. --Comp. --दंडः unerring in punishment, N. of Śiva. --दर्शिन्, --दृष्टि a. of unerring mind or view. --बल a. of never-failing strength or vigour. --वाच् f. words not vain or idle, that are sure to be fulfilled or realized. (a.) one whose words are not vain. --वांछित a. never disappointed. --विक्रमः of never-failing valour, N. of Śiva.

m: अ-मोघ—भूति m. N. of a king of the Pañjāb.
अ-मोघ—बल mfn. of never-failing strength (said of the horse Uccaiḥśravas).
अ-मोघ—दण्ड m. ‘unerring in punishment’, N. of Śiva.
अ-मोघ—दर्शन m. ‘of an unfailing eye’, N. of a Nāgī, Buddh.
अ-मोघ—दर्शिन् m. N. of a Bodhisattva.
अ-मोघ—देव m. N. of a poet, Cat.
अ-मोघ—दृश् mfn. of an unfailing look or eye, BhP.
अ-मोघ—किरण n. pl. ‘the unerring rays’, N. of the rays, immediately after sunrise and before sunset, VarBṛS.
अ-मोघ—नन्दिनी f. N. of a Śikṣā-text.
अ-मोघ—पाश m. N. of a Lokeśvara, Buddh.
अ-मोघ—पतन mfn. ‘not falling in vain’, reaching the aim, Rājat.
अ-मोघ—राघव m. N. of a drama, ib.
अ-मोघ—राज m. N. of a Bhikṣu, Lalit.
अ-मोघ—सिद्धि m. N. of the fifth Dhyānibuddha.
अ-मोघ—ता f. unerringness (of a weapon), Kir.
अ-मोघ—वाञ्छित mfn. never disappointed, L.
अ-मोघ—वाच् mfn. whose words are not vain, BhP.
अ-मोघ—वर्ष m. N. of a Caulukya prince.
अ-मोघ—वती f. N. of a river, RV.
अ-मोघ—विक्रम m. ‘of unerring valour’, N. of Śiva.
अ-मोचनीय mfn. not to be liberated.
अ-मोचन n. not loosening or letting go, L.
अ-मोचन &c. See अ-मोक्य.
a: अमोचनं — Not loosening or letting go, non-liberation.

m: अ-मोचित mfn. not liberated, confined.
अ-मोच्य mfn. = ˚चनीय, q.v., Ragh. iii, 65.
अ-मोह m. (with Buddhists) freedom from ignorance (one of the three roots of virtue), Dharmas. 138.
अ-मोक्य mfn. (√ मुच्), that can not be unloosed, AV. iii, 6, 5.
a: अमोक्य — a. Ved. Not to be unloosed.

m: अ-मोक्ष mfn. (√ मोक्ष्), unliberated, unloosed, L.
अ-मोक्ष m. want of freedom, bondage, confinement
non-liberation (from mundane existence).
a: अमोक्ष — a. Not liberated, unloosed. --क्षः 1 Bondage, confinement. --2 Non-liberation from worldly existence.

m: अ-मोक्षयत् mfn. not liberating, Yājñ. ii, 300.

v: na॰ amA saha Utam vye--kta । acCinnadaSavastrayugme “amotaM vAso dadyAdDiraRyamapi dakziRAm” aTa॰ 9, 5, 14
m: अमोत &c. See s.v.
अमोत mfn. woven at home, AV.; Kauś.
a: अमोत — a. [अमा-उत] Ved. The hems or skirts of which are not cut; woven at home, taken care of or protected at home; ˚पुत्रका a maiden protected at home.

m: अमोतक m. protected at home (as a child) [‘a weaver’, NBD.] AV. xx, 127, 5.
a: अमोतकः — 1 One protected at home (as a child). --2 A weaver (?).

m: अमोत—पुत्रक m. a child protected at home [a weaver's boy, NBD.] AV. xx, 127, 5.

s: puM, (amlaM rasaM sarvvatra patrapuzpAdO atati vyApnoti, amla + ata + aR vA lasya ratvaM, pakze amlAtaH .) AmrAtakavfkzaH ॥ iti SabdamAlA ॥
v: pu॰ amlaM rasaM sarvvatra patrapuzpAdO atati vyApnoti ata--aR vA rasya latvam । (AmaqA) AmrAtakavfkze । svArTe kan amrA(mlA)tako'pi ।
m: अम्रात m. = आम्रात, q.v., L.
a: अम्रातः --तकः — A species of hog-plum; see आम्रातक.

s: puM, (amlaM rasaM sarvvatra patrapuzpAdO atati vyApnoti amra + ata + aR + svArTe kan .) AmrAtakavfkzaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (“AmrAmrAtakajambUtvak kazAye vipacedbuDaH । yavAgUM SAliBiryuktAM tAM BuktvA grahaRIM jayet” ॥ iti SArNgaDaraH ॥)
m: अम्रातक m. = आम्रात्˚, q.v., VarBṛS.

s: puM, (amati sOraBeRa dUraM gacCati, ama + ran .) AmravfkzaH । Pale klIvaM । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: pu॰ amati sOraBeRa dUraM gacCati ama--ran । Amravfkze । PalapatrAdO na॰ । evaM prAyaH sarvvatra vfkzavAcakezu ।
m: अम्र m. = आम्र, q.v., L.
a: अम्र — = आम्र q. v.

m: अमु a pronom. base, used in the declension of the pronom. अदस्, that (e.g. acc. अमुम्, अमूम्; instr. अमुना, अमुया; dat. अमुष्मै, अमुष्यै, &c.)
अ-मुख [TS.] or अ-मुख [ŚBr. xiv], mfn. having no mouth.

v: tri॰ muKyam viroDe na॰ ta॰ । muKyaBinne praDAnaBinne gORe ।
m: अ-मुख्य mfn. not chief, inferior, Jaim. &c.

v: avya॰ amunA prakAreRa TAl । amunAprakAreRetyarTe “itTaM naH sadyo'muTAsadyoH na etadatikrAmAditi” Sata॰ vrA॰ ।
m: अमुथा ind. thus, in that manner, like that, Nir.
with √ 1. अस्, ‘to be thus’ (a euphemistic expression used in the sense of) to fare very ill, ŚBr.
a: अमुथा — ind. Thus, in that manner, like that; ˚अस् to be thus, euphemistically for ‘to fare very ill’.

m: अ-मुच् क्, f. not setting at liberty, ŚBr.
a: अमुच् — f. Ved. Non-liberation.

m: अ-मुची f. ‘not setting at liberty’, N. of an evil spirit, AV. xvi, 6, 10.
a: अमुची — f. Ved. Not unbinding, not setting at liberty (said of an evil spirit).

m: अमुदा ind. then, at that time, Śaṃkar.
अ-मुद्र mfn. having no seal (by which to prove one's self legitimate), MBh.; Hariv.
having no impression or image of one's self, having no equal, Kathās.

v: tri॰ amumaYcati adasa + anca kvip adryA gamaH uttvamatve । 1 adaH SabdArTaprApte 2 tatpUjake ca । SasAdO amudrIcaH । pUjArTe amudryaYcaH । striyAM NIp ।
m: अमुद्र्यञ्च् or अमुमुयञ्च्, mfn. turned in that direction, Vop.

v: tri॰ na mugDaH 1 mugDaBinne । mugDaH mohAnvitaH manoharaSca । 2 mugDAvasTAtItaprOQAyAM striyAM strI ।
m: अ-मुग्ध mfn. not foolish, not perverse, ŚBr.
अमुकीय mfn. belonging to such and such a person, IndSt.

s: tri, budDisTatvopalakzitatattatDarmmAvacCinnaM । svasvavfttiviSezaDarmmapuraskAreRa tattadvastuvAcakaM । PalanA iti BAzA । adasSabdasya aki kfte sorottvABAve ako'kArasya uttve amuka iti Bavati amuka ityAgamikaM । iti kramadISvaraH ॥ yaTA, -- “amukAmukagotrEtat tuByamannaM svaDA namaH” । iti SrAdDatattvaM ॥ (aBivAdaye iti SabdoccAraRAnantaraM amukanAmAhamasmIti svaM nAma parikIrttayet । iti kullUkaBadfH । “saMniveSaM pramARaYca svahastena liKet svayam । mataM me'mukaputtrasya amukasya mahIpateH” ॥ iti nAradaH .)
v: tri॰ adas + werakac uttvamatve । adaHSabdArTe “atrAhamamukaH sAkzI” “samApte'rTe fRI nAma svahastena niveSayet mataM me'mukaputrasTa yadatropari leKitam” ca yA॰
m: अमुक mf(आ)n. such and such a person or thing, a thing or person referred to without name, Yājñ.
a: अमुक — pron. a. [अदस्-टेरकच् उत्वमत्त्वे Tv.] A certain person or thing, so and so (to be used when a person or thing is referred to without a name); मतं मेऽ मुकपुत्रस्य यदत्रोपरिलेखितम् Y. 2. 86-87; उभयाभ्यर्थितेनैतन्मया ह्यमुकसूनुना . लिखितं ह्यमुकेनेति लेखकोंते ततो लिखेत् 88.

s: klI, (muc + ktaH, na muktaH viroDe naYsamAsaH .) CurikAviSezaH । iti halAyaDaH ॥ hAtaCurI iti BAzA । muktirahite atyakte ca tri ॥ (aprAptamocanaH । asvatantraH । “amuktA BavatA nATa muhUrttamapi sA purA” । iti sAhityadarpaRe । “amukto mAnasErduHKEricCAdvezasamudBavEH” । iti mahABArate । KaqgAdikaM । yaduktam, -- “KaqgAdikamamuktaYca niyudDaM vigatAyuDam” । iti .)
v: tri॰ na muktaH viroDe na॰ ta॰ । muktaBinne 1 badDe “sadA prahfzwayA BAvyaM vyaye cAmuktahastayA” manuH । 2 sasaMsArabanDayukte ca na mucyate sarvvadA yoDEH । hAtaCurI) । 3 CurikABede na॰
m: अ-मुक्त mfn. not loosed, not let go, not liberated from birth and death, not liberated from Rāhu, still eclipsed, Viṣṇus.
अ-मुक्त n. a weapon that is always grasped and not thrown (as a knife, a sword, &c.)
a: अमुक्त — a. 1 Not loosened, not let go. --2 Not liberated from recurring birth and death, not having got final beatitude. --क्तं A weapon (a knife, sword &c.) that is always grasped and not thrown. --Comp. --हस्त a. one whose hand is not open or free (to give), sparing, stingy (in a bad sense); frugal, economical, prudent (in a good sense); सदा प्रहृष्टया भाव्यं व्यये चामुक्तहस्तया Ms. 5. 150.

m: अ-मुक्त—हस्त mf(आ)n. ‘one whose hand is not open (to give)’, sparing, economical, Mn. v, 150.
अ-मुक्त—हस्त-ता f. economy, frugality, Viṣṇus.
अ-मुक्त-विश्रम्भ mfn. with unshaken confidence (अम्, ind.), Bcar.

v: strI aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 1 muktyaBAve muktirmocanaM rajjvAdibanDananivfttiH saMsArabanDnivfttirUpomokzaSca । na॰ ba॰ 2 muktiSUnye tri॰ ।
m: अ-मुक्ति f. non-liberation, L.
a: अमुक्तिः — f. 1 Non-liberation. --2 Want of freedom or liberty.

v: tri॰ amumaYcati adas anca--kvip gatO na lopaH adryAdeSaH adrerapi uttvamatve । 1 adaH SabdArTaM gate tatpUjake ca SasAdO amumu IcaH amumuYcaH striyAM NIp ।

m: अमुर्हि ind. at that time, then, ŚBr.; BṛĀrUp.
a: अमुर्हि — ind. Then, at that time.
अमुतः — ind. 1 From there, there. --2 From that place, from above, i. e. from the other world or heaven. --3 Upon this, thereupon; henceforth.

m: अमुतः-प्रदान n. an offering from there, TBr.

v: avya॰ amuzmAt adasa + tasil uttvaBatve । 1 amuzmA dityarTe 2 paralokAdityarTe ca “itaAjAto'mutaH kutaScit f॰ 1, 179 4 ।
m: अमुतस् ind. from there, there, RV.; AV.
from above, from the other world, from heaven, ŚBr.; Nir.
hereupon, upon this
(= abl. अमुष्मात्) from that one, Daś.
अमुत्रार्थम् ind. for the sake of (existence in the) other world, Mn. vii, 95.

s: vya, (amuzmin adas + tral uttvamatve .) janmAntaraM । paralokaH । ityamaraH ॥ (amuzmin ityarTasya vAcakaH । “anenEvArBakAH sarvve nagare'mutra BakzitAH” । iti kaTAsaritsAgare । BavAntare । janmAntare । “taTEva yaH kzamAkAle kzatriyo nopaSAmyati । apriyaH sarvvaBUtAnAM so'mutreha ca naSyati” । “icCadBiH satataM Sreya iha cAmutra cottamaM” ॥ iti mahABArate .)
v: avya॰ amuzmin adas tral uttvamattve । 1 amuzminnityarTe 2 paraloke ityarTe ca “yattu bARijake dattaM neha nAmutra tadBavet” manuH ।
m: अमुत्र ind. there, AV.; ŚBr. &c.
there above i.e. in the other world, in the life to come, VS.; ŚBr. &c.
there i.e. in what precedes or has been said, ŚBr.
here, Kathās.
a: अमुत्र — ind. (opp. इह) [अदस्-त्रल्] 1 There, in that place, therein; अमुत्रासन् यवनाः Dk. 127. --2 There (in what precedes or has been said), in that case. --3 There above, in the next world, in the life to come; यावज्जीवं च तत्कुर्याद्येनामुत्र सुखं वसेत्; यत्तु वाणिजके दत्तं नेह नामुत्र तद्भवेत् Ms. 3. 181; Bg. 6. 40. --4 There; अनेनैवार्भकाः सर्वे नगरेऽमुत्र भक्षिताः Ks. --5 Thither, that way. --Comp. --भूयं Ved. being in the other world; dying.

k.v: स्वाहा हा देवहविर्दाने श्रौषट्वौषट्वषट्स्वधा। किञ्चिदीषन्मनागल्पे प्रेत्यामुत्र भवान्तरे॥

v: na॰ amutra Bavanam BU--BAve kyap । paralokaBavane “amutraBUyAdaDa yadyamasya” SrutiH ।
m: अमुत्र—भूय n. being or going there (in the other world), dying, AV. vii, 53, 1 (= VS. xxvii, 29).

a: अमुत्रत्य — a. Belonging to a future life, being of the next world.

v: avya॰ amuzyeva vati vede uttvamatve । amuzyevetyarTe “manuzvadBaratavadamuvaditi yajamAnArTe yAnyAha” kAtyA॰ 3, 2, 7 ।
m: अमु—वत् ind. like such person or thing (referred to without name), KātyŚr.
a: अमुवत् — ind. Like a person or thing referred to without name.

m: अमुया ind. (instr. f.) in that manner thus or thus, RV.; AV.
with √ 1. अस्, or √ भू, to be gone, be lost, ŚBr.
a: अमुया — ind. Ved. In that manner, thus and thus.

m: अमुष्मिन् ind. (loc. sg. of अदस्) in the other world, L.
(forms the base of आमुष्मिक, q.v.)

v: pu॰ amuzya apatyam Pa (PaY) aluk । viKyAtakulotpanne apatye amuzyApatye ca ।

m: अमुष्य (gen. sg. of अदस्), of such a one.
a: अमुष्य — (gen. of अदस्) Of such a one (in comp. only). --Comp. --कुल a. [अलुक् स.] belonging to the family of such a one. --(लं) a wellknown family. --पुत्रः, --त्री the son or daughter of such a one or of a good or well-known family or origin; see आमुष्यायण.

v: na॰ 6 ta॰ ni॰ aluk । prasidDakule । manojYA॰ vuY Amuzyakulakam tadBAve kOlInye na॰ ।
m: अमुष्य—कुल mfn. belonging to the family of such a one, (gaṇas प्रतिजनादि and मनोज्ञादि, q.v.)
अमुष्य—पुत्र m. the son of such a one (i.e. of a good family, of known origin), (g. मनोज्ञादि, q.v.)

s: puM, strI, (amuzya putraH nipAtanAt aluk samAsaH .) praKyAtavaMSodBavaH । kulInaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ (“syAdAmuzyAyaRastvAryyo'muzyaputtro mahAkulaH” । iti jawADaraH .)

v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ ni॰ aluk । praKyAtavaMSe kulIne tasya BAvaH manojYA॰ vuY Amuzyakam । kOlInye na॰ ।

a: अम्व्लः — Sourness.

m: अम्यक् ind. ‘towards, here’ (Nir. & Sāy. on RV. i, 169, 3), but See √ म्यक्ष्.
a: अम्यक् — Ved. Towards, near.
